import importlib.util, json, sys, datetime
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('/testbed')
parser_path = repo / 'qa_instances_eval/cfnlint_qa/jsonschema_sub_def_use_pairs/files/tests/qa/parser.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qa_parser', parser_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

# load test module
case_path = repo / 'qa_instances_eval/cfnlint_qa/jsonschema_sub_def_use_pairs/files/tests/qa/testcase.py'
spec2 = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qa_testcase', case_path)
case_mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2)
spec2.loader.exec_module(case_mod)

TARGET_PATH = str((repo / 'src/cfnlint/jsonschema/_resolvers_cfn.py').resolve())
TARGET_FUNC = 'cfnlint.jsonschema._resolvers_cfn.sub'
lines=[]

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    code = frame.f_code
    path = str(Path(code.co_filename).resolve())
    if path == TARGET_PATH:
        func = f"{frame.f_globals.get('__name__')}.{code.co_name}"
        if func == TARGET_FUNC and event in {'call','line','return','exception'}:
            ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S,%f')[:-3]
            lines.append(f"{ts} {path}:{frame.f_lineno} {func} event={event} ")
            return tracer
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    t = case_mod.TestJsonschemaSubDefUsePairsQA()
    t.test_jsonschema_sub_def_use_pairs_case()
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)

trace_text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
source_text = (repo / 'src/cfnlint/jsonschema/_resolvers_cfn.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
defs_by_line, uses_by_line, tracked_vars, _ = mod.build_def_use_maps(source_text)
observed = mod.extract_observed_pairs(trace_text, defs_by_line, uses_by_line, tracked_vars)
print(json.dumps(observed, indent=2))
